composition_subtypes.role: Sort by courier delivery time to define greedy candidate deliveries
Binary search on split index to minimize max(parallel delivery, serial pickup)

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort by a_i, then binary search optimal split to minimize max(max a_i[0..k], sum b_i[k+1..n]).
payload.rationale: Sorting enables monotonic property: as k increases, max a_i increases and sum b_i decreases, allowing binary search.
